summary:
Strategic Data & Machine Learning Professional with 6+ years of experience driving
business transformation through advanced analytics across Supply Chain & Logistics
(3PL), Banking/BFSI, and E-commerce ecosystems. Possess 5+ years of hands-on
expertise in predictive modeling, regression analysis, credit risk scoring, loan eligibility
modeling, customer segmentation, and demand forecasting.
Experienced in architecting scalable ML solutions using Python, MLOps frameworks, and
Cloud Platforms (GCP/Azure), enabling data-driven decision-making across financial risk
management, supply chain optimization, and digital commerce growth strategies. Proven
ability to convert complex data landscapes into structured, automated, and governance-
aligned analytical systems delivering tangible ROI.
